name: superpowers-planning-only
description: A planning-only subset of Superpowers for brainstorming, specification, and implementation planning workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Brainstorm ideas, write specs, and produce executable implementation plans.
interface.longDescription: A slim Codex plugin derived from Superpowers 5.1.0 that keeps only the planning flow: brainstorming, writing implementation plans, and executing written plans inline. Debugging, TDD, code review, worktree, and completion workflow skills are intentionally omitted.
defaultPrompt: Help me turn this idea into a plan.
Write an implementation plan from this spec.
